checkpoint: Native explicit-market reading writes and current consent for device synchronization

checks.independent_review: Web agent independently reviewed ReadingsScreen, readings helper and healthSync; no additional confirmed P1/P2. No live HealthKit/Health Connect device run.

changes.manual_readings: Visible Angola/Portugal selector and Portuguese consent context; explicit country and consent_language pt, source manual. Current five mandatory grants are checked before the write, and the server rechecks them. Missing device authorization does not block a manual reading. Unknown response preserves form input and advises checking history before repeating, without an automatic retry or UUID/no-duplicate guarantee.
changes.device_connections: Only bounded owner+country+language metadata is stored under the existing connection key. Old owner-only connections fail closed and require explicit reconnection. A live connection cannot silently change its market; same-scope reconfirmation retains its existing cursor. No new native dependency, OS permission or device provider was added.
changes.sync: Current required grants plus optional devices consent are checked before permission requests and sample reads, including retries. Every unchanged sample chunk carries the same captured scope and original external identity. Same-owner concurrent syncs share one operation. Connection epochs and session generations invalidate disconnected/replaced in-flight reads and prevent stale writes or cursor commits. Cursors advance only after all batches return successfully; denied/uncertain batches retain previous cursors.
changes.personal_history: Retained history remains accessible after consent withdrawal. Consent-required failures do not erase loaded readings; generic auth access loss clears them. Network/read errors preserve loaded rows and never fabricate an empty success. Legacy null market is displayed as unknown. Reads and operations are owner/session/lifecycle scoped; focus/foreground refreshes state. Existing native screen has no CSV import or delete controls; no consent restriction was added to those server APIs.
